description: Office of the Public Service Commission - Service Minute of the Sir Lanka Principals Service Fourth Amendment
reasoning: This gazette contains amendments to the Service Minute of the Sri Lanka Principals Service, which deals specifically with public service recruitment qualifications, confirmation conditions, and service regulations. It falls under Public Service Gazettes as it concerns public sector service conditions, qualifications, and administrative procedures for education sector personnel, without involving government structural changes, specific personnel appointments with detailed portfolios, or other specialized categories.
